criteria.criterion: It is established which absolute URLs the review-bot app can emit (same-app-only; RCA comment).
A request to `https://<host>/review/<route>/` receives a `Location` retaining the `/review/` prefix, verified by a structural test over the rendered nginx config.
The existing prefix-stripping request behaviour is unchanged: `GET /review/health` still reaches the app as `GET /health`.
[non-codebase] LIVE VALIDATION (DEFERRED to operator edge-deploy): an unauthenticated probe of `/review/health/` on the deployed edge shows a `Location` resolving to the health endpoint.
Bug '/review/ redirects lose the /review/ prefix, so the Location 404s on Gerrit' is actually resolved: the reported defect no longer reproduces and expected behavior holds.

findings.criterion: [non-codebase] LIVE VALIDATION (DEFERRED to operator edge-deploy): an unauthenticated probe of `/review/health/` on the deployed edge shows a `Location` resolving to the health endpoint.
findings.detail: This non-codebase criterion requires a concrete attestation of a live probe on the deployed edge. The ticket snapshot contains no such attestation — no comment with a specific reference id/URL, observed outcome (e.g., actual HTTP response), or timestamp for the live validation. The criterion is explicitly marked as DEFERRED to a future operator edge-deploy gated on bug 1d1b + operator apply, and the ticket itself states 'Not deployed here; not blocking.' No live-validation evidence is visible in the ticket snapshot I read.
findings.remediation: When the operator edge-deploy is performed (after bug 1d1b + operator apply), record a ticket comment naming: the deploy reference id/URL, the actual HTTP response observed (e.g., `GET /review/health/ -> 307 Location: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/review/health`), and the timestamp of the probe. This will satisfy the non-codebase criterion.

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: use the evidence path that matches each one. For codebase-verifiable work, complete any unfinished work and make its proof discoverable in the repository. For evidence that inherently lives outside the repository, mark the criterion with the exact `[non-codebase]` tag and add a comment to this ticket that documents the concrete artifacts that meet it (commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the evidence to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so properly tagged evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. An untagged external criterion cannot be satisfied by a ticket comment alone. Then re-verify. Note that a finding reporting a ticket record as absent means it was NOT VISIBLE IN THE TICKET SNAPSHOT THE VERIFIER READ — that snapshot is pinned when the run starts, so a record written after the pin, or not yet committed to the store, reads as missing even though it exists; re-verify after the write lands rather than re-recording evidence you already wrote.
